statement.zh: 所有祭祀坑均为同一场礼仪事件的产物，与分期/测年差异及新坑资料相冲突的风险高，属假说。
statement.en: Treating all sacrificial pits as products of one single ceremony conflicts with phasing/dating diversity and new-pit data—hypothesis only.
